accepted_scope: Frozen recorder_v1 and model-only core_v3 source/mock integration for actually admitted native model success or failure; does not establish actual recorder/model/auditor execution.

checks.model_only_semantics: AST comparison confirms every frozen core_v2 model require statement remains verbatim; only future recorder validation is separated, with ended-only nonpromotion check retained.
checks.frozen_auditor_compatibility: Real candidate record success orchestration output passes unchanged frozen core_v2.validate when an independent future root recorder terminal is supplied, for either genuine tool_call or distinct tool_session.
checks.true_failure: Real negative signal exit -9 and ordinary nonzero exit preserved in failed schema with missing success receipts; unchanged successful frozen validator rejects it. Pre-admission failure is intentionally outside this recorder and must remain separate root evidence.
checks.running_handoff: Authenticates complete original intent/predecessor chain, exact expected_running object and stable latest identity after real exit, without pretending dead model owners are live or projecting a new idle tip. Only admitted failed-before-publication can use original full pre-admission freshness.
checks.source_lease_physical: Original retained-descriptor acquisition and zero-exclusion authority, full source partition plus strictly additive recorder closure, all loaded-source checks, inherited nine-native receipt and identity stats, saved original physical pair and fresh complete current/history pair including model unit/owners remain.
checks.resources: Original2GiB/600s/900s/2MiB independent metadata budget, original root28GiB/NVMe30GiB floors, complete finite output inventory with original file/native128MiB/total256MiB/root allocation, partial failure inventory allowed only under original bounds.
checks.immutability: Reads only fixed original runtime JSON; does not open raw/native/driver journals/results/runtime.log. Rechecks present/absent receipts and owned drain; writes one independent atomic terminal outside model tree and never records its own exit.

integration_notes: Recorder imports frozen auditor_v2/core_v2 as helpers; its source extension must contain every missing dependency from the full580-file closure, plus recorder/core_v3, minus all original model pins. Later audit extension must include actual recorder catalog pins.
Root must retain actual model session and terminal outcome. The current serial catalog rejects negative exit codes; do not normalize a true negative signal or invent success to satisfy it.
Root creates true external recorder exit and then terminal handoff/catalog only after recorder ends; do not publish an idle successor before recorder validates the original model running tip.
Only actually admitted runs with admission/intent/source-authentication/predecessor-drain can be recorded by this entrypoint; earlier actual failures stay root-owned separate evidence.
limitations: No actual large metadata/source traversal, physical/systemd/proc/lock/read operation was performed during this review.
Full physical/source/system IO are mocked in recorder orchestration; previously accepted full nested physical implementation is retained and not changed.
Root concrete recorder spec/review and actual external model/recorder/tool outcomes are still required.
